stem: Which investigation may accompany urinalysis in an individualised paediatric renal work-up?

options.text: A mandatory DMSA scan for all children
A mandatory MCUG for all children
CT as the universal first investigation

explanation: Renal Doppler/abdominal ultrasound may accompany urinalysis in an individualised renal work-up. The investigation set is tailored to the child, rather than using a universal imaging mandate.

citations.title: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf

rationale: Urinalysis may be paired with ultrasound-based renal imaging, and the work-up is individualised.

optionExplanations.A: Correct because renal Doppler/abdominal ultrasound is a listed investigation that may accompany urinalysis.
optionExplanations.B: Incorrect because DMSA scanning is not described as mandatory for all children.
optionExplanations.C: Incorrect because MCUG is not described as mandatory for all children.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because imaging may be part of the work-up rather than being excluded altogether.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because CT is not described as the universal first investigation.
